page_title: UNI 0-2 BOC | Union Berlin v Bochum 14/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+30' That's it for today, Martin Petersen has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+25' The match can continue after the interruption.
90+4' The game is interrupted.
90+2' Patrick Drewes (Bochum) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
90+1' Patrick Drewes (Bochum) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
89' Here is a change. Moritz Broschinski is going off and Dieter Hecking gives the last tactical orders to Philipp Hofmann (Bochum).
89' Substitution. Ibrahima Sissoko walks off the pitch and Dani de Wit (Bochum) comes on as a substitute.
87' The corner is sent into the box by Robert Skov, but Danilho Doekhi (Union Berlin) flashes the ball a whisker past the left post.
86' Union Berlin will take a corner kick.
84' The corner is swung in but Bochum can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
81' Robert Skov (Union Berlin) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort.
80' The substitution is prepared. Yorbe Vertessen (Union Berlin) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Rani Khedira.
79' Bo Svensson decides to make a substitution. Tom Rothe will be replaced by Janik Haberer (Union Berlin).

79' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) finds some space inside the box and gets in a strike, but the shot is brilliantly blocked by one of the defending players sliding in.
78' The goalkeeper dives to deny Moritz Broschinski (Bochum), whose promising shot was aimed towards the left post.
77' Bernardo (Bochum) latches onto the ball after a scramble in the box, but his placed effort towards the left side of the goal is far too weak and Frederik Ronnow makes a simple save.
76' Martin Petersen has a clear sight and sees a foul from Rani Khedira (Union Berlin).
74' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Maximilian Wittek as he is replaced by Jakov Medic (Bochum).

73' Union Berlin players are playing combination football and attempting to create a goal-scoring opportunity, but they will have to wait for that as they have just lost possession due to a poor pass. The ball goes out of play and Bochum will have a goal kick.
73' The attendance is 22012.
70' It seemed like Robert Skov (Union Berlin) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
69' My grandmother could have scored that! Robert Skov (Union Berlin) blazed the ball just over the bar from close range! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bochum.
68' Bo Svensson has decided to make a change. Laszlo Benes (Union Berlin) replaces Woo-Yeong Jeong.
68' Aljoscha Kemlein (Union Berlin) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Andras Schafer.
67' Kevin Vogt (Union Berlin) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
65' Robert Skov (Union Berlin) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
61' Some neat passing and movement from Union Berlin as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
57' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Robert Skov (Union Berlin), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
56' Bo Svensson has decided to substitute Tim Skarke and he is replaced by Jordan Siebatcheu (Union Berlin).
53' Danilho Doekhi (Union Berlin) leaps highest to meet the resulting set piece and sends his header way off target. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bochum.
53' Robert Skov (Union Berlin) will take the corner.
52' Robert Skov (Union Berlin) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent. The linesman makes the right call and Union Berlin will have a corner.
50' Moritz Broschinski (Bochum) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
47' Celebrations by Union Berlin are cut short as the referee signals that the penalty decision will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully it won’t take too long.
47' Referee Martin Petersen reverses his original decision after the VAR review. There was no infringement and subsequently it’s not a penalty.
47' Bernardo (Bochum) trips an opposition player and Martin Petersen signals a foul. No point in arguing there. Union Berlin will take a penalty kick.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+5' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' Danilho Doekhi (Union Berlin) does well on the edge of the box to find space and powers a shot in on goal that just goes over the bar.
45+3' Robert Skov (Union Berlin) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bochum.
45+2' Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) has to stretch for the ball in the box and sends it just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bochum.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
44' Robert Skov (Union Berlin) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
42' Union Berlin are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
37' Substitution. Gerrit Holtmann leaves the pitch and is replaced by Anthony Losilla (Bochum).
37' Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) is arguing with the referee and is given a caution.
36' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Bochum comes to nothing.
35' Bochum take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
33' 1 - 1 Goal! Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom left corner. He makes it 1:1.
32' Andras Schafer (Union Berlin) lets fly with a decent effort from the edge of the box that flashes just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Bochum will have a goal kick.

28' Rani Khedira (Union Berlin) creates a yard of space for himself and tries an effort from the edge of the box, but it goes just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Bochum will have a goal kick.
26' It's a throw-in for Bochum.
23' 0 - 1 Ibrahima Sissoko (Bochum) rises high to beat the goalkeeper with a perfect header. He heads the ball into the bottom right corner.

19' Robert Skov (Union Berlin) runs with the ball towards the keeper and pulls the trigger from close range, but Patrick Drewes anticipates his intention and makes an amazing save to stop the shot going into the middle of the target.

18' Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) takes the chance to have an effort at goal from inside the box but misses to the right of the target. The ball goes out of play and Bochum will have a goal kick.
16' None of the Union Berlin players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bochum.
13' Koji Miyoshi (Bochum) is being sent off by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier!

11' Moritz Broschinski (Bochum) had a good chance to change the score. He ran towards the goal and unleashed a shot from just outside the penalty area which went towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper was ready and made an amazing save.
11' A spell of possession for Bochum in an attempt to control the game.
6' Martin Petersen blows his whistle and it's Moritz Broschinski (Bochum) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee. A free kick has been awarded to Union Berlin.
3' Corner kick. Bochum will have an opportunity.
3' Bochum have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
2' The ball is out of play and Bochum manage to earn a corner.
1' Tim Skarke (Union Berlin) latches onto a loose ball inside the box but slams it just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Bochum will have a goal kick.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! Bochum will take the kick-off.
